<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 14"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Barrier of Boreal Frost](/Feats.aspx?ID=4278) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cold" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=27" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 33

</column>

---

You form an intricate structure of ice, such as a wall of bricks made of packed snow or a screen of enormous icicles. This has the effect of a [_wall of ice_](/Spells.aspx?ID=364) spell with a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. It can only be a wall (not a hemisphere), and you choose whether the ice is transparent or opaque. The wall lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.
name: Barrier of Boreal Frost
